name: Paneer Do Pyaza
subtitle: paneer with onion twice over, once melted into the gravy and once in soft petals

ingredients.qty: 5, two chopped fine and three in petals
ingredients.note: the name means two onions, and it is literal

prepNotes: The two onions do different jobs. The chopped one dissolves into the gravy; the petals go in at the end and must stay separate and sweet.
Take the yogurt off the heat before it goes in, or it splits.

steps.text: Fry the chopped onion in oil for 12 minutes until deep brown, then add ginger and garlic.
Add the ground spices with a splash of water, then the tomato, and cook until the oil separates.
Take the pan off the heat, whisk in the yogurt, and only then return it to a low flame.
steps.tip: Off the heat, always. Yogurt added to a hot pan curdles instantly.

steps.text: Simmer 5 minutes with a little water to a thick gravy.
In a separate pan sear the onion petals hard for 2 minutes so they colour but keep their bite, and add the paneer for a minute.
Fold the petals and paneer through the gravy, add kasuri methi and garam masala, and rest 5 minutes off the heat.

storage: Keeps 2 days refrigerated. The onion petals soften overnight, which loses the contrast the dish is named for.
